commit.subject: LU-20435 ec: fix zfs guards in sanity-ec
commit.message:
LU-20435 ec: fix zfs guards in sanity-ec

With dmu_offset_next() detection working, sanity-ec tests 5b and 12c
must be disabled for ZFS because hole detection is working fallocate
is called which unavailable for ZFS and so these tests fail now.

Test-Parameters: trivial
Test-Parameters: testlist=sanity-ec fstype=zfs
Signed-off-by: Marc Vef <mvef@whamcloud.com>
